scripts.dev: bun run build && bun --bun x web-ext run --source-dir dist --start-url https://www.twitch.tv --start-url https://kick.com
scripts.lint: bun run build && bun --bun x web-ext lint --source-dir dist --warnings-as-errors
scripts.package: bun run build && bun --bun x web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
